title: An explicit test-body budget for two real publish CLI starts
summary: The negative publish integration case was the only publish-suite body still using Vitest's implicit five-second deadline. Its two real Node CLI starts exceeded that deadline in main CI. The author adds only a 60-second per-body budget; assertions, requests, hooks, global defaults, process deadlines and domain performance policy remain unchanged.
proves: The actual main failed job records the sole no-registry/usage timeout, with 117 other prove tests passing and three configured skips. All five sibling publish cases already have explicit 300- or 900-second body budgets. The focused unchanged CLI assertions pass once against the existing real fixture: missing registry exits 2 with its message, and missing flags exit 2 with usage. Five siblings are unselected by the filter, not newly skipped. Fresh prove lint/typecheck and cleanup pass. Fresh main CI on the recovery commit remains the conductor's next verification.

captions.00-main-ci-failure: Actual main CI timeout and surrounding test results; the complete failed job log is preserved under attempts.
captions.01-suite-budget-scope: All six publish bodies and the package config: only the negative CLI body lacked an explicit deadline.
captions.02-focused-real-cli-check: The actual focused no-registry/usage case passes once with its real registry/OIDC/workerd fixture.
captions.03-prove-static-checks: Fresh prove lint and typecheck, without Nx cache.
captions.04-cleanup-proof: No publishing fixture container, reserved 9050–9053 listener or runtime process from this worktree remains.
